verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.crewai.com that indexes the docs, including API reference entries. Every docs page has a .md version that points agents back to that index, and versioned LLM-oriented markdown snapshots are published. The installation docs also offer a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents that installs the official CrewAI skills and points the agent at the right docs. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents successfully using these agent-oriented docs in practice.
